\section{Problem}

Research summaries often omit evidence links. We introduce a retrieval-backed communication workflow for research papers.

\section{Method}

The method ranks evidence chunks with sparse retrieval and attaches the selected chunk identifier to every generated claim.

\[
\mathrm{coverage} = \frac{\text{claims with citations}}{\text{all claims}}
\]

\section{Finding}

Citation coverage makes it easier for a reader to verify where a statement came from.
